title: Remove unreachable English-only default parameter values in AppIntroScreen's _IntroPage
why: Both call sites (_buildSubtitleBlock at line 292 and its internal call to _subtitleRich) always pass an explicit talmidChochomLabel: terms.talmidChochom argument, so these English-literal defaults can never actually render -- dead code that also looks like (but isn't reachable as) an AX-2 violation, wasting a reviewer's attention when auditing for hardcoded strings.
recommendation: Make the parameter `required String talmidChochomLabel` (drop the default) so the compiler enforces callers always supply the localized value.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze clean after making the parameter required (proves no call site relied on the default)
